requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that validate the prescription behavior schema accepts valid structured data defined in S1 without errors.
The system must include unit tests that fail when required schema fields for prescription behavior data are missing.
The system must include unit tests verifying transformation logic correctly normalizes prescribing patterns into display-ready values.
The system must include unit tests verifying condition-to-label mapping produces consistent and expected labels for known conditions.
The system must include unit tests confirming calculation of score contribution returns a valid numeric value within expected bounds.
The system must include integration tests verifying the prescription behavior component renders correctly within MessageBubble when provided complete valid data.
The system must include integration tests verifying that missing prescription behavior data results in a defined fallback UI state without runtime errors.
The system must include integration tests verifying that partial prescription data renders only available sections and omits incomplete elements gracefully.
The system must include tests ensuring no console errors or warnings are emitted during rendering of the prescription behavior component.
The system must include tests verifying that MessageBubble correctly integrates and positions the prescription behavior component in the expected message flow order.
The system must include tests ensuring transformation logic produces deterministic output for identical inputs across runs.
The system must include tests validating that invalid data types in prescription input are rejected or handled without crashing the UI.
The system must include tests verifying that LLM-generated prescription behavior content, when conforming to schema, renders identically to non-LLM data inputs.
The system must include tests ensuring that LLM-generated prescription data that violates schema constraints is safely rejected or sanitized before rendering.
The system must include tests verifying that LLM-generated partial prescription outputs still produce a valid fallback UI without breaking MessageBubble rendering.
